headline: Türkiye Market Regulator Revokes Operating Licenses of Brokerage Tera Yatırım
summary: Türkiye’s Capital Markets Board (SPK) has revoked all operating licenses and the authorization certificate of brokerage house Tera Yatırım Menkul Değerler.
why: Brokerage revocations by the SPK enforce compliance and solvency standards within the Borsa Istanbul trading ecosystem.

impacts.name: Tera Yatirim Menkul Degerler AS
impacts.why: The full revocation of operating licenses forces the cessation of brokerage activities.
